summary: Modern & Stylish Two-Bedroom Apartment in Prime Central Darlington With Secure Gated Access Situated in the heart of central Darlington, this stunning two-bedroom apartment enjoys an enviable location overlooking the ever-popular Coniscliffe Road, leading directly into the vibrant town centre.
description:
With an abundance of wine bars, restaurants, boutique shops, and cafés just steps from your door, this home offers the perfect balance of city convenience and contemporary living. Set within a secure gated development, the apartment complex benefits from a well-maintained communal entrance with an intercom entry system, ensuring both privacy and peace of mind for residents. The apartment enjoys a prime location just a short stroll from Darlington town centre, situated just moments from Coniscliffe Road offering an array of local amenities and excellent transport links. This well presented apartment is perfect for professionals, first-time buyers, or investors seeking a property in a sought-after location with modern comforts and secure living. This fantastic apartment briefly comprises of; entrance hall , open-plan lounge, dining area and kitchen, two double bedrooms, both generously sized, with the master bedroom benefiting from an en-suite and family bathroom. The apartment is currently tenanted, achieving a monthly rental income of £700 PCM, making it an ideal investment opportunity for landlords seeking a ready-made rental property with an immediate return. The existing tenancy provides stability, while the property's location and quality ensure continued demand from professional tenants.

COMMUNAL ENTRANCE A secure entry system leads into the well-kept communal areas, providing a welcoming first impression.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hallway offers access to all rooms, laminate flooring, radiator and entrycom system.

OPEN-PLAN LOUNGE, DINING & KITCHEN AREA The heart of the home, this expansive open-plan space is designed for modern living. The lounge area is bathed in natural light, thanks to French doors that create a bright and airy feel which in turn leads onto a balcony , perfect for outdoor summer seating. There is plenty of room for comfortable seating, making it the perfect space for both relaxation and entertaining. With laminate flooring and radiator. The dining area seamlessly connects to the living space, providing ample room for a dining table-ideal for hosting friends or enjoying family meals. The stylish and well-appointed fitted kitchen boasts a range of modern base and wall units, providing ample storage while maintaining a sleek and contemporary aesthetic. The laminate work surfaces are complemented by contrasting splashbacks, adding a touch of elegance to the space. A stainless steel inset sink unit with a drainer and mixer tap enhances functionality, making meal prep and clean-up effortless. High-quality integrated appliances include an oven, hob, and stainless steel chimney extractor unit, ensuring a professional cooking experience. The kitchen also benefits from an integrated microwave, washer/dryer, dishwasher, and fridge freezer, offering convenience and efficiency. Natural light floods the space through two charming sash windows, enhancing the bright and airy feel. A radiator ensures year-round comfort, while laminate flooring adds both style and practicality.

BEDROOM ONE A spacious and private retreat, the master bedroom boasts generous proportions, providing ample space for a king-sized bed and additional furnishings. The room is bathed in natural light from two elegant sash-style windows, enhancing its bright and airy feel. For added convenience, the bedroom features built-in robes, offering excellent storage solutions while maintaining a sleek and uncluttered aesthetic. A radiator ensures warmth and comfort throughout the year, making this the perfect space to unwind and relax.

EN SUITE The master bedroom benefits from a well-appointed en-suite, featuring a fitted white suite designed for both style and functionality. The double shower cubicle is equipped with an inset mains-fed shower, offering a refreshing and luxurious experience. A wash hand basin and WC are neatly set into a sleek vanity unit, providing both storage and a streamlined look. Tiling to the splash areas and vanity, along with a fully tiled floor, enhances the contemporary feel while ensuring easy maintenance. Additional features include a radiator for warmth and an extractor fan, maintaining ventilation and comfort in this modern en-suite space.

BEDROOM TWO The second bedroom is another spacious double, offering versatility as a guest room, home office, or additional living space. Featuring built-in robes, it provides ample storage while maintaining a clean and uncluttered aesthetic. Natural light streams in through two elegant sash-style windows, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The laminate flooring adds a modern touch, while a radiator ensures warmth and comfort throughout the year.

FAMILY BATHROOM The well-appointed family bathroom features a fitted white suite, comprising a panelled bath, a wash hand basin, and a WC set into a stylish vanity unit, providing both functionality and storage. The space is enhanced by part-tiled walls, which complement the contrasting tiled floor, creating a modern and elegant look. Two sash-style windows allow natural light to fill the room, adding to the airy and inviting ambiance. A radiator ensures warmth and comfort, making this bathroom both practical and relaxing.

EXTERNALLY The apartment building offers exceptional security, with access gained through wrought iron security gates, ensuring a safe and private living environment. Beyond the gates, a well-maintained courtyard provides allocated car parking, offering residents convenience and peace of mind. Additionally, the development benefits from visitor parking, making it easy for guests to visit without hassle. This secure and well-designed setting enhances the appeal of the apartment, combining modern living with practicality in a sought-after location.
